registered: 2026-11-24, before any run below; numerical validation (evidence.json, 30/30) is reused, not repeated

A_chance_corrected_and_agreement_estimat.gate: estimand consistency at N = 20000 units, 3 raters (2 for two-rater methods), q = 4 uniform categories (2 for PABAK): independent raters -> target 0 for chance-corrected coefficients, 1/q for percent agreement and Bangdiwala B; |estimate - target| <= .02; identical raters -> exactly 1 (|diff| <= 1e-12)

B_kappa_inference.gate: R = 1000: 95% CI coverage at true kappa .5 within .95 +/- .02; z test Type I at kappa = 0 within [.036, .064]

C_icc.scope: complete n = 30 subjects x k = 4 raters, normal effects
C_icc.gate: R = 1000 per model: estimand consistency (mean estimate within .03 of the population ICC at n = 2000, one run); 95% CI coverage within .95 +/- .02 under the matching model (one-way data for ICC(1,.), two-way random for ICC(2,.), two-way with fixed rater effects for ICC(3,.)); F test Type I at ICC = 0 within [.036, .064]

D_correlation_and_concordance.gate: R = 1000: Type I within [.036, .064]; Pearson Fisher-z CI coverage at rho = .5 within .95 +/- .02

E_marginal_homogeneity.gate: R = 1000: Type I <= .064 (discrete tests: upper bound only; continuity-corrected McNemar is conservative by design)

F_bland_altman.gate: R = 1000: 95% CI coverage of the bias within .95 +/- .02; of each limit of agreement (approximate Bland-Altman 1999 SE) within .95 +/- .02

mc_precision: R = 1000 gives MCSE ~ .007 for .95 and ~ .0069 for .05; the +/- .02 and [.036, .064] bands are ~3 and 2 MCSE
status_rule: A method is CERTIFIED for an output only if every gate of its family that applies to that output passes; outputs without an applicable gate stay NUMERICALLY VALIDATED; failures are recorded, never hidden
